articles.title: '20 villas in Udaipur, 8 in Alwar': Why IAS officer, IPS wife face corruption probe
articles.summary: Senior IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal faces a preliminary inquiry by the Anti-Corruption Bureau. He has been accused of misusing his official position to benefit Goyal Fashions Private Limited.

articles.title: German, Slovak nationals die in Bengaluru hotel pool; US tourist among injured
articles.summary: On Friday evening, two foreign nationals from Germany and Slovakia died from suspected electrocution in a hotel swimming pool. A US national and an Indian pool attendant were injured while trying to rescue them.

‘If you want to fit Vaibhav’: Ex-cricketer's message to Gambhir on Sooryavanshi
articles.summary: Dinesh Karthik asserts that India should consider resting Abhishek Sharma if they wish to include Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in the lineup. This comes after Sooryavanshi missed the fourth T20I, allowing Ishan Kishan to recover.

articles.title: Judge Blocks Farm Amphitheater: court backs conservation easement; landowner may appeal
articles.summary: A recent ruling by a Superior Court judge has put the brakes on the proposed outdoor amphitheater at Union Grove Farm, North Carolina. The Triangle Land Conservancy raised alarms over land-use regulations intended to safeguard agricultural landscapes.

articles.title: US organ donation group faces decertification after Kentucky man’s near-fatal ordeal
articles.summary: TJ Hoover II's case raised critical alarms when he showed signs of life just before organ retrieval, prompting intense scrutiny of patient safety protocols. Testimony from Donna Rhorer revealed disturbing insights about operational practices.

Atlanta Bilateral Meeting: Jaishankar meets Rubio on G20 FMM sidelines; focus on India–US cooperation
articles.summary: External affairs minister S Jaishankar had a productive meeting with US secretary of state Marco Rubio in Atlanta to explore avenues for enhanced bilateral ties. They shared reflections from their recent talks during the G20 foreign ministers' summit.

articles.title: AICTE extends Industry Fellowship Programme 2026-27 registration deadline to October 31: Check complete details here
articles.summary: The All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) has extended the Phase 2 registration deadline for the Industry Fellowship Programme 2026-27 to October 31. Eligible organisations can apply online at ifp.aicte.gov.in.

articles.title: TNPSC CTS hall ticket 2026 released for Field Assistant post: Check key details and direct link to download admit card here
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) has released the CTS Hall Ticket 2026 for the Field Assistant post under the Combined Technical Services Examination (Diploma Level)-II. Candidates can download their admit cards from tnpsc.gov.in using their Application Number and Date of Birth.

articles.title: NEET UG 2026: Around 2,000 MBBS seats vacant, MCC announces special stray vacancy round; registration from November 2
articles.summary: Around 2,000 MBBS seats remain vacant after multiple NEET UG 2026 counselling rounds. DGHS has announced a Special Stray Vacancy Round, with MCC opening registration on November 2.

articles.title: UGC asks colleges and universities to observe BRICS Sustainable Lifestyle Week 2026 from November 1
articles.summary: The UGC has asked universities and colleges to participate in BRICS Sustainable Lifestyle Week 2026 from November 1 to 7 under Mission LiFE. The initiative will focus on seven themes, including energy conservation, water management, sustainable food systems and waste reduction.

articles.title: SRK's King breaks overseas rights record at Rs 175 crore
articles.summary: Shah Rukh Khan’s ‘King’ has broken the overseas rights record, with Phars Films reportedly paying a Rs 175 crore minimum guarantee. To break even, the film must earn Rs 350-375 crore abroad, matching ‘Pathaan’ and ‘Jawan’.

articles.title: 'Athimanoharam': Antony against expecting 'Narasimham'
articles.summary: The anticipation for Mohanlal's upcoming film 'Athimanoharam' is palpable among fans. Producer Antony Perumbavoor has cautioned audiences against drawing comparisons with earlier hits like 'Narasimham'.

articles.title: Sree Vishnu starrer 'Comrade Kalyan' OTT release details
articles.summary: Comrade Kalyan made its theatrical debut and is now streaming online, featuring Sree Vishnu and Mahima Nambiar. Directed by Janakiram Marella, this film is set in the 1990s and focuses on Kalyan's transformative journey through love.

articles.title: Pa Ranjith’s 'Vettuvam' locks Pongal 2027 release
articles.summary: Director Pa Ranjith gears up for the highly anticipated release of 'Vettuvam' in January 2027, just in time for Pongal. Starring Arya and Dinesh among a sprawling ensemble cast, this film explores intense power struggles in a post-apocalyptic world.
